name: buttons
note: The button icons, asked of the AI judge: Hector at the courtyard door (no icon there, its arrows turn green) and the controller settings page. Xbox icons by default; --set button_layout=1 for the PS2 ones (from an HD pack made from the PS2 game).

steps.note: to the door, the way the first-save recording went
the door: its arrows turn green this close, no button is shown for it

ask.question: Is there a controller button icon on the screen, for instance a prompt to open the door, and which controller is it from?

choices.xbox: an Xbox button: a coloured ball with a letter (A green, B red, X blue, Y yellow), an L or R trigger box, or a white or black round button
choices.playstation: a PlayStation button: a circle, cross, square or triangle symbol, or an L1, L2, R1 or R2 label

ask.question: Which controller's button icons does the screen show beside the actions?

choices.xbox: an Xbox button: a coloured ball with a letter (A green, B red, X blue, Y yellow), an L or R trigger box, or a white or black round button
choices.playstation: a PlayStation button: a circle, cross, square or triangle symbol, or an L1, L2, R1 or R2 label
